note: Founder decision for all five Motion apps (USD base). Store consoles hold the authoritative per-region prices; the app shows store-localized prices only. Console creation/readback is a user input.
accessModel: First part of every course free (shortest whole-module prefix covering >= 1/3 of lessons); remaining lessons need a Lissom or Motion+ subscription; practice records always readable.

freeTrial.motionPlusOncePerAccount: Founder K3 (Core R3): the Motion+ trial is granted once per Motion account across the five apps. iOS 16+: the server signs introductoryOfferEligibility=false for later apps; iOS 15 keeps Apple's per-group eligibility (observed limit, S13). Play: Motion+ trial offers are Developer determined with tag motion-plus-trial.

motionPlusScope: Unlocks the paid parts of all five Motion apps (Lissom, Gravita, JabLab, Ostinato, Choreia) for the same Motion account.
notIncluded: Camera sessions stay closed in this release.

trialOffer.eligibility: New customer acquisition (never had this subscription)

freeLessons.status: current app counts (Lissom freeLessonLimit override of Core isLessonUnlocked); founder approval pending (K-7)

storeNotifications: App Store Server Notifications v2 and Play RTDN go to the Core motion-store-notifications function (Core R3 K2); renewals, cancellations and refunds update the account's entitlement without waiting for the app.

appleGroupLevels.note: Motion+ ranks above the single-app plan inside 'Motion membership' (catalogue); intro offer 'Free, 2 weeks' once per subscription group
